induction_probe.definition: repeat contiguous token windows sampled from the frozen task prompts; score second-copy token i attention to first-copy token i+1 minus mean attention to non-target first-copy positions
induction_probe.global_score: mean of the five highest per-head induction-minus-baseline means

qk_probe.selection: all frozen single-variable rows at k=4

transition_rules.abrupt_transition_reliability: bootstrap detection fraction >=0.95 and >=0.50 of detected bootstrap steps within one checkpoint index of the point estimate
transition_rules.bootstrap: hierarchical resampling of seed, then items within seed; 2000 replicates
transition_rules.estimator: right endpoint of the largest positive adjacent-checkpoint level change
transition_rules.immediately_follows: same or next checkpoint in the preregistered ordered grid
transition_rules.taxonomy_requirement: within-stale share rises and other-error share falls across S_stale
